payload.title: File:Various dinosaurs hendrickx.jpg
payload.description_html:
Reconstructed skeletons of members of the six major groups of the clade Dinosauria.
From the top to the bottom, and from the left to the right: Tyrannosaurus rex (Theropoda). "Sue". Original. Field Museum, Chicago, U.S.; Camarasaurus lentus (Sauropodomorpha). Original. Sauriermuseum of Aathal, Switzerland; Gastonia burgei (Ankylosauria). Cast. Sauriermuseum of Aathal, Switzerland; Stegosaurus stenops (Stegosauria). Cast. Natural History Museum, London, England, UK.; Maiasaura peeblesorum (Ornithopoda). Original and cast. Field Museum, Chicago, U.S.; Triceratops horridus (Marginocephalia). Original. American Museum of Natural History, New York, U.S.
